LanguageData.WotF_LivingWood.label: living wood
LanguageData.WotF_LivingWood.description: Living wood cut from the forest's oldest trees. It is still growing: flexible, warm to the touch and slow to burn.
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSteel.label: elven steel
LanguageData.WotF_ElvenSteel.description: A pale blue-silver metal drawn from living wood. Light, keen, and it carries a weave as readily as it cuts.
LanguageData.WotF_Adamantine.label: adamantine
LanguageData.WotF_Adamantine.description: A cold, heavy dark-gold metal. Nothing else in the colony is harder to break, and it does not burn.
LanguageData.WotF_Mithril.label: mithril
LanguageData.WotF_Mithril.description: A moon-white metal that feels weightless. Weaves cling to it, so armour and blades made from it take spells into themselves.
